scope: Identical evaluation-mix request bodies across all three runs; two partial attempts and one completed run. These are selections, not the breadth-v1 index.
record_origin: Existing shared-request comparison; the pairwise disagreement range was recomputed on the 670 shared request bodies from the three runs' HTTP journals.
precision: Percentages and maximum probability delta retain the existing comparison's reported precision.
excluded: Request bodies, generated text, images, predictions and raw journals.
